## Required

All five ROS 4.2.0 fields are mandatory: trip/set identities, light type, colour and number.

## Available

The 2025 review covers 67 trips (17 observer-monitored, 50 self-reporting) and 461 sets.

Light type and colour are populated for 457 sets. Lights-per-basket and basket counts exist for all sets.

Four sets record zero lights per basket. That needs checking before deciding whether to report a light row.

## To decide

Confirm that multiplying lights per basket by basket count gives the requested total.

Agree type/colour conversions, especially mixed and unknown values. Missing information must not become zero.

Mixed categories cannot be split without counts for each type/colour combination.

The database allows settings without light rows. Reporting requirements remain open.
